description: Leitungsnetz Trinkwasser Stadtwerke Uelzen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Stadtwerke Uelzen GmbH is a modern energy supply company in the heart of the Lüneburg Heath and offers you all services relating to energy from a single source. Under the mycity brand, the company supplies the city of Uelzen with 100% green electricity in addition to natural gas and water. Coverage: DE.
